## Detailed Project Case Studies

### Project 1: SafeSpeak
- **Description**: Anonymous multilingual peer-support platform providing judgment-free real-time communication.
- **Event**: Built in 24 hours at SPEC Industry Hack 2026 (National-level Hackathon).
- **Problem Solved**: Students and young individuals often experience distress or anxiety but avoid seeking support due to stigma, fear of identity exposure, or language barriers.
- **Solution & Architecture**:
  - Users enter without creating long-term accounts via Firebase Anonymous Authentication.
  - Language matching pairs individuals based on preferred spoken tongues.
  - Built-in real-time translation powered by Google Translation API bridges English and Hindi conversations.
  - Realtime messaging powered by Firebase Realtime Database with active safety and reporting triggers.
- **Links**:
  - [SafeSpeak Live Website](https://spih-146.vercel.app/)
  - [SafeSpeak Source Code](https://github.com/MohammedSarfaraz-droid/SafeSpeak.git)

### Project 2: LumeNoor
- **Description**: High-conversion web agency landing page designed to market design and frontend engineering services.
- **Architecture**: Next.js static export with Tailwind CSS styling, optimized typography, and responsive grid layouts.
- **Links**:
  - [LumeNoor Live Website](https://lumenoor.com/)
  - [LumeNoor Source Code](https://github.com/MohammedSarfaraz-droid/LumeNoor.git)
